verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud has a public pricing page with a free tier (grafana-docs-13) and community commentary confirms cost is a known, comparably cheap differentiator (grafana-comm-7), suggesting pricing information is accessible without sales contact. However, the evidence pack lacks any concrete published per-signal unit rates (e.g., $/GB logs, $/series metrics, $/trace) that would let an SRE precisely model costs, and no mention of enterprise tiers requiring sales engagement is contrasted against self-serve tiers. Missing for 10: explicit per-signal pricing tables/units, confirmation that all tiers (including enterprise) publish self-serve rates, and independent verification that published prices match real invoiced costs.
